description: Header file defining the BlobCache class for in-memory and disk caching of compiled program blobs, including hash utilities and cache management functions.

classes.name: BlobCache
classes.description: A cache for storing compiled program blobs in memory and optionally on disk, with methods for cache management.

classes.name: BlobCache::Value
classes.description: Represents a cached blob with a pointer to data and size, does not own the memory.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the cache, with optional application callback.

methods.name: putApplication
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the application cache if callbacks are set.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Repopulates cache with a key-value pair, specifying source (memory or disk).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a blob from the cache using a key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Evicts a blob from the cache by key.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the cache, discarding current contents.

methods.name: entryCount
methods.description: Returns number of entries in cache.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Reduces cache size to a limit, returning bytes freed.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns current cache size in bytes.

methods.name: maxSize
methods.description: Returns maximum cache size in bytes.

methods.name: areBlobCacheFuncsSet
methods.description: Checks if external cache functions are set.

methods.name: isCachingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if caching is enabled based on callbacks or size.
